info.name: IoTeca IoT Platform — API Tests
info.description:
Complete API test suite covering authentication, project management, data ingestion, device management, alert rules, data query, admin stats, and EMQX webhooks.

**Run order:** Execute folders top-to-bottom. Variables are set automatically by test scripts.

**Timeliness:** Every request asserts response time < 500 ms.

**Auth:** Folder 1 (Auth) sets `access_token` and `refresh_token`. Folder 3 (API Keys) sets `api_key_full`. Ingest requests use the API key; all other protected requests use the JWT.

**Async note:** Folders 5 (Devices) and 7 (Data Query) depend on Kafka consumers having processed ingest messages. Allow a few seconds after running folder 4 before running these.
